match.search: Search by invoice, partner or reference

match.entryHint: For what has no invoice: fees, interest, transfers.

batches.title: Payment batches
batches.subtitle: Collect from customers and pay suppliers in one go.
batches.newHint: Choose the due amounts. Nothing is collected until you close it.
batches.withProblems: {count} chosen lines are missing data: a bank format may reject them.
batches.noCandidatesHint: Issued invoices with debt that are not already in another batch show up here.
batches.emptyHint: Create one to collect or pay several due amounts in one go.
batches.loadError: The batches could not be loaded.

next.draft: Generate the file and upload it to your bank. Nothing goes out on its own.
next.generated: Upload it to your bank. Once accepted, close it: that is when the payments are created.

closeMessage.collection: Collections for {amount} are created, with their journal entries. Do it once the bank has accepted it.
closeMessage.payment: Payments for {amount} are created, with their journal entries. Do it once the bank has accepted it.

batches.deleteMessage: Its due amounts become free for another batch. If you already uploaded the file to the bank, cancel it there.
batches.returnHint: Its payment is cancelled and the journal entry reversed: the invoice owes that amount again. Mark the bank's charge for this as ignored in Reconciliation: the entry is already done.

partner.mandateHint: To collect from them by batch.
